verdict.rationale: The docs show incremental insertion into an existing Orama database via `insert` and `insertMultiple`. For Orama Cloud, they say data sources are segregated so you can "update, delete, or add new data" without affecting other sources, and that frequently updated data can sit in its own source. That points to incremental changes rather than a full rebuild, but the evidence never states that changes become searchable in near real time. Missing for 10: explicit update/delete document APIs in the open-source library, a stated near-real-time or immediate searchability guarantee, an explicit statement that no full reindex is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
